name: soundHandle
meaning: Sound_Play channel: 0x95 while the gem slides (0x4b36ed), 0x8f once it is seated (0x4b38d1); Update stops it when the slide flag drops (0x4b3645)

name: zone
meaning: ZONE property (Scn_GetPropBox prop 8, 0x4b33f4-0x4b3405); the rectangle whose objects the seated gem teleports (0x4b3903-0x4b393b)

name: unk06c
meaning: never read or written by the class

name: traj
meaning: TRAJ property (Scn_GetPropTrajectory prop 4, 0x4b328c-0x4b329d); only its first and last points are used

name: sliding
meaning: bit 0 of the byte at +0x90: set while a non-zero turn arrives (or al,1 0x4b36c2), cleared by PostLoadInit / Reset / a zero turn (and al,-2)

name: startPos
meaning: traj->pts[0] (0x4b32a3-0x4b32e1); the gem interpolates from here

name: endPos
meaning: traj->pts[count-1] (0x4b32e8-0x4b335f); SetPosition target once progress reaches 0xc00 (0x4b37d0)

name: progress
meaning: sum of the signed turn amounts of msg 0x42 (0x4b3707-0x4b371a); the gem is seated at 0xc00

name: percent
meaning: progress * 100 / 0xc00 (0x4b3737-0x4b374f); the interpolation weight, in percent

name: homePos
meaning: pos at load with the vertical replaced by endPos.y (0x4b3433-0x4b345b); Reset puts the gem back here

name: teleported
meaning: 0 at load, 1 once the zone has been teleported (0x4b39e8); never read by this class

name: state
meaning: 0 loose, 1 seated; compared and stored by SetState (0x4b387e-0x4b3895) and tested by HandleMessage (0x4b368c)

name: teleportDx
meaning: width in x of BOXTELEPORT (max.x - min.x, 0x4b3419-0x4b342c): the offset every object in the zone is moved by, and the argument of msg 0x43
